dct_description_sm:
Includes all types of stormwater catch basins within the City of Waterloo storm sewer system. Catchbasins are essential inlet structures that drain excess rain from paved streets, parking lots, roofs, etc.

Please be advised that these records are based upon available information, compiled from a variety of sources, some of which has not been verified. This is not a plan of survey, field verification is recommended.
